title: Instant Coffee, pre-lightened and pre-sweetened with sugar, reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: Instant Coffee, pre-lightened and pre-sweetened with sugar, reconstituted (5207) is a ready‑to‑drink product made from roasted coffee beans that undergo extraction, subsequent lightening and sweetening with sugar, then dried into a powder. When hot water is added it dissolves quickly, producing a fragrant beverage.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Instant coffee was first produced commercially in the early 20th century.
Lightening reduces acidity, giving the coffee a milder taste.
Pre‑sweetening with sugar makes the drink ready to consume without extra sweeteners.
This type of coffee is often used in military rations and expedition kits because of its lightweight nature.
Reconstituted indicates that the product already contains all additives needed for a finished drink.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, increasing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine can slightly raise metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Caffeine promotes gastric secretions, supporting digestion.

items.title: Reduced risk of certain diseases
items.content: Moderate coffee consumption is linked to lower risk of Parkinson’s disease and type‑2 diabetes.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Pre‑sweetened coffee raises the glycemic index and may be unsuitable for diabetics.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Despite lightening, coffee remains acidic and can irritate the stomach if consumed in excess.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: Rare, but possible allergic reactions to coffee components.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add 1‑2 teaspoons (≈5‑10 g) of powder to 200 ml of hot (not boiling) water, stir until fully dissolved. Optionally add milk, cream, or spices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed container in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 3‑6 months, ensuring no moisture or off‑smells develop.
